entries.test: Corporate filings, company announcements, and contemporaneous leadership records would establish Lyu’s roles, Rabbit’s manufacture of the R1, and whether Cyber Manufacture Co. and Rabbit Inc. were the same legal entity as of publication.
entries.note: “Was and is” refers to the publication date, not the evaluation date.

entries.test: Corporate filings, archived GAMA offerings and customer communications, Rabbit sales records, and funding announcements would establish corporate continuity, the timing of withdrawal from GAMA users, gadget sales, and the $30 million raised by publication.
entries.note: “From what I can tell” qualifies the evidential basis of an asserted observation. “Disappearing on its users” has a plain contextual reading of ceasing project updates and customer engagement.
The central commitment is a demand for an apology; evidence cannot settle whether one is owed.
The claim asserts an obligation to provide explanations, which is a normative judgment.
